subject: SIG follow-up — final artifacts requested for vendor assessment
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@bluecrest.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Olivia Kerr <okerr@bluecrest.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up — final artifacts we need

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the SIG submission last week — the questionnaire looks good. Security flagged a few final items before we can move to legal:

1) Current SOC 2 Type 2 report (latest opinion)
2) Executive summary of the most recent penetration test — high/critical findings only and remediation status
3) ISO/IEC attestation or formal statement if available (ISO27001 or equivalent)
4) A short security deck (5-7 slides) we can use in our internal review that summarizes architecture, data flows, and controls

Could you deliver those artifacts by end of day Wednesday (BlueCrest time)? If something is sensitive, a secure share link is fine — we just need the reference and expected delivery timeline.

Also FYI — procurement will request a vendor security contact for an attestation call; name and phone/email would be helpful.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,

—Samir
Samir Patel
Vendor Risk Manager, BlueCrest Financial

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — final artifacts we need

Samir — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything requested. Quick notes: 

- SOC 2 Type 2 (opinion) — final report available for 2027, will share PDF.
- Pen test executive summary — we have a redacted two-page summary that lists critical/high findings and current mitigation status; will confirm whether to include full triage notes.
- ISO statement — we maintain ISO statements for select regions; will attach the formal attestation PDF.
- Security deck — will prepare a concise 6-slide deck tailored to vendor review.

We’ll aim to get all artifacts to you by Wednesday 23:59 EDT (Thursday 03:59 UTC). If you need them earlier, tell us which item to prioritize.

Vendor contact for attestation call: Vanessa Ortiz, Head of Trust (vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com, +1-415-555-0183).

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Samir — attaching the files we discussed. Note on the pen test doc: we've redacted internal IPs and some vendor PII; the summary highlights the 3 findings that were rated "high" in the engagement and current mitigation timelines.

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf; PenTest_Summary_2028.docx; ISO27001_statement_2026.pdf; Redwood-Security-Deck-v3.pdf

Best,
Vanessa

From: Olivia Kerr <okerr@bluecrest.com>

Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 02:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — final artifacts we need

Vanessa / Irene — received, thanks. We reviewed the deck and the SOC 2 report. A couple of clarifying asks before we close the packet: 

- In the pen test summary, can you add a single-line status for CVE references (e.g., whether CVE tracking/patching is in place) for the high findings?
- Security wants one-line confirmation that logs for production inference endpoints are retained for a minimum of 90 days and are available for export to third parties under a data request.
- Can you confirm whether the ISO statement covers the Redwood Private (VPC) deployment or is limited to hosted environments?

If you can drop an updated one-page note addressing those three bullets, procurement will finish redlines and loop legal. DocuSign ready on our side once we confirm.

Regards,
Olivia Kerr
Senior Vendor Analyst, BlueCrest Financial
